title: Connectors and cohesion
grammar: Linking words (however, although, because, so that, in order to)
function: Link ideas and give coherence to the text

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn the most common linking words to connect ideas and make your writing more coherent.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. I stayed home because it was raining. Although he was tired, he finished the race. She studied hard, so she passed. Notice: because = reason, although = contrast, so = result.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: ___ it was late, we decided to keep working.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write a short paragraph about a difficult day using at least 3 linking words.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: I studied a lot, ___ I passed the exam.
